items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: And a fellow by the name of William Eber, he was a Jamaican, he played baritone... I played trombone there.

ctx.x: Now what instruments did they play?

Johnny Wilson played baritone. Willie Wilson and Willie Paggio played trumpet. And Landry, did you name it? Al C. He trumpet. Al C. would die. Yeah, that's right. And Andrew Stevens played bass. Oscar Grammer played bass, which Oscar, they tell me he has a stroke now. I don't know, I haven't saw him in years, I don't know. And as I told you, Johnny Wilson was baritone. And a fellow by the name of William Eber, he was a Jamaican, he played baritone. And a fellow by the name of Jones, he played clarinet. And Oscar…
Maybe if we stopped and got the picture, we could refresh your memory a little bit that way, would that help? There's a picture, hand in some place, do you know where it is?
